Class ClientContainerPanel

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.containers.api.slot.ClientContainerPanel
public final class ClientContainerPanel extends Object
The client half of a ContainerPanel (§0067): what only the client has, declared from the client initializer. 
ClientContainerPanel.of("inventory-plus:pockets")
    .chrome(() -> List.of(Button.builder()...build()))   // the panel's own elements
    .parity(ScreenMatcher.allExcept(...));               // default: every container screen
A container panel with neither needs no call here: its slots are presented on every container screen. Containers builds each panel (chrome, then the slots as a SlotFlowElement) and wires its adapter at client start, after every client initializer has run.

    • parity

      public ClientContainerPanel parity(ScreenMatcher scope)
      The screens that show the panel. Default ScreenMatcher.all(); opt one out with ScreenMatcher.allExcept(Class...). The slot data is on every container menu either way; this scopes only where it is shown.

    • wireAll

      @Internal public static void wireAll()
      Builds each registered container panel (chrome, then its slots flowing and wrapping to the panel's width) and wires a ScreenPanelAdapter scoped by its parity. Called by Containers at client start, before declarations freeze.
